en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Jameel, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The people came to be upon three types – a scholar, and a student, and scum. So we<sup>asws</sup> are the scholars, and our<sup>asws</sup> Shia are the students, and the rest of the people, are scum’ (worthless).
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from Jamil who has said the following. “I heard Imam abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) saying, ‘
People become of three groups: Scholars, those who learn and garbled ones. We are the scholars. Our followers are the ones who learn. The rest of the people are garbled ones.’”
